info.title: Citebase: get cited by AI
info.description: Plain-language SEO and get-recommended-by-AI helper. Start with POST /run using tool get_playbook and name start, then follow it. Saves nothing unless you give a project name; then it saves in your own Apify account.

post.summary: Run one Citebase tool (use this one)
post.description: Runs one Citebase tool and returns JSON {ok, tool, result}. First call in a new chat: {"tool":"get_history","arguments":{}} to see saved projects, then {"tool":"get_playbook","arguments":{"name":"start"}} and follow that playbook. Tools and their arguments: get_playbook {name?} lists or reads guidelines; audit_site {url?, max_pages?, project?} checks a public website (project saves it and shows what was fixed since the last check); quote_cost {pack} (starter, keywords, competitors, creators, local, ai_check) or {items:[{job,units,requests?}]} prices paid data jobs and returns run_caps, the spending cap for each separate Actor run (start each paid run once; if it is still running, check it with get-actor-run instead of starting it again); measure_recommendation_share {panel,runs,baseline?,current?,experiments?,brand?} or {project} computes how often AI recommends the brand in buying questions; next_steps {project?,audit?,report?,max_steps?} makes a plain to-do list (with project it reads the saved results itself); check_outreach_draft {to,subject,body,suppressed?,sent_today?,daily_cap?} checks an email and never sends; check_ai_content {text,threshold?} lints a draft for AI-writing patterns and never calls an API; save_results {project, runs?, panel?, brand?, audit?, settings?, todo?, server_log?, traffic?, traffic_csv?, gsc_csv?, ranks?, fact_checks?, check_only?, append?, replace?} saves progress, settings (country, language, device, frequency) and to-do updates under a project name; get_history {project?, answer_review?} shows progress over time, or every saved project when project is empty; make_report {project, prospect?} makes a shareable one-page report link; import_ai_results {project, snapshot, dataset_ids?, items?, save?, append?, replace?, panel?, brand?, context?} reads results by dataset id (dataset_ids) and converts results of AI Brand Monitor, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and the tracker Actors (send panel and brand with save true to start a project in one step; context is the country, language and device of the run); schedule_checks {project, url?, frequency?, max_pages?, platforms?, repeats?} gives steps, the Actor runs to add (repeats 1 to 5, default 3, for the assistants) and the worst-case monthly cost for automatic re-checks; scheduled_check {project, url, max_pages?, ai_import?} is the site check plus report refresh meant for an Apify Schedule. true/false fields must be real booleans. Errors return {ok:false,error} with what to fix. Nothing is saved unless a project name is given; saved data stays in the caller's own Apify account. project_work {project,operation,data?} manages signed-in project records, reviewed changes, schedules and outreach. Use operation project_focus with an optional priority and limit to read the project inbox. Start or resume website setup with onboarding_get, review and save its competitors and terms, then use research_get for observed results. The project-work playbook covers onboarding, evidence imports, Google reporting and approved mail handoffs.

arguments.description: Inputs for the chosen tool as JSON, for example {"name":"start"} or {"url":"https://example.com"}. Defaults to {}. Never put passwords or tokens here.

apifyRoutingBearer.description: Bearer credential used by the Apify Server Actor gateway.

id.description: Stable saved action or finding ID.

record_id.description: ID used to open the original record in its dashboard section.

evidence_url.description: Safe public HTTPS source or link to saved evidence within this project.

counts.description: Disjoint whole-project counts before filtering and limiting.

total.description: The number of distinct pending items across the whole project.

matched_total.description: The number matching the selected priority before the limit.
